remarks: Step into the timeless character and spaciousness of this beautiful Victorian-style home, ideally situated on approximately two acres close to Chautauqua Lake and some of the area's most desirable summer destinations like Bemus Point and Chautauqua Institution, while several ski resorts are less than an hour away for year-round recreation. The inviting foyer is a room of its own, featuring a beautiful wood-paneled staircase that immediately showcases the home's classic character. The oversized living room provides an abundance of space and flexibility, with plenty of options for furniture placement and creating distinct seating areas. A stone gas fireplace serves as a warm and welcoming focal point. The updated kitchen offers an excellent layout with abundant cabinetry and generous counter space, along with two farmhouse sinks—one conveniently located in the island and another along the side counter. The kitchen opens naturally into the bright dining area, where an abundance of windows fills the space with natural light. A separate breakfast room just off the kitchen provides the perfect spot for morning coffee and features a sliding glass door leading to a covered patio. The main level also offers the convenience of a laundry room and an updated half bath. Upstairs, you'll find four bedrooms, including a fourth bedroom that can also function beautifully as an office or flex space and is accessed by its own staircase from the dining room. An unfinished sunroom on the second level offers exciting potential for additional living, hobby, or relaxation space. The updated full bath features a large walk-in shower. Outside, enjoy two additional covered porches, a spacious and private yard, and plenty of room for gardens, landscaping, recreation, or simply relaxing outdoors. A large storage shed provides additional storage, while the garage beneath the home adds convenient utility space. With its combination of character, thoughtful updates, generous living spaces, private acreage, and proximity to Chautauqua Lake, Bemus Point, Chautauqua Institution, and winter recreation, this property offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of the area in every season.
